headline: BOS @ KCR matchup research

Batter research is strongest for Bobby Witt Jr., Maikel Garcia, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
